svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 382 mm of 25 x 25 x 1.6 tube; cut both ends square, deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 6.6 mm hole across through both walls 12 mm from each end:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the two holes are 357.8 mm apart. Drill with the tube flat in a vice.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit a 6 mm aluminium crush sleeve (21.8 mm long) at each hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the brace runs at 45 degrees from the clip on the bracket plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up to the clip under the arm (253 mm up and 253 mm out),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on one M6 pin at each end. It holds the arm level and takes the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: load of anything hanging on the head.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hole centres within 0.5 mm; with the arm level, both pins
